gaps_proposed.reason: PR01 is self-examination against one's own conduct — whether one is a doer of the word rather than a hearer. Verses 6-7 are a worshipper escalating what he might bring, not a man examining what he has done. The reviewer's word 'audit' is doing the work here, not the definition.

The reviewer's own wording gives the reason: it calls this the social breakdown that Absorbing the Blow is built to heal. A passage describing the condition a practice addresses is not an anchor for that practice. Nobody in these verses is absorbing a blow or failing to; trust has simply gone. This is a new error type worth naming — condition mistaken for practice, distinct from the name-versus-definition error.

record_correction: A claim written into the review brief two rounds ago — that every addition the reviewer had proposed failed the definition test — was inaccurate when written. The synthesis pass had already produced four accepted additions. The running tally is eleven proposed: four accepted, one in part, six declined. The brief has been corrected to state the record rather than the three failures that were front of mind.
